stages.action: Choose one ready unit from ads.json or organic-calendar.json. Skip needs-consent units until a signed social-media release exists.
Resolve layoutId and endCardLayoutId in design-system.json. Paint only with token names. Run buildPromptPrefix() for any generated frame. The end card is always layout video-end-card.
Run the social pipeline test. No prices, no guarantee, no Dr. Szarski, no invented patient, no unsourced percentage, no fake scarcity.

Shoot or generate the scene. Clinic footage uses approvedMedia only. Generated people are allowed for the denture-slip concept and must look lived-in, with no extra facial or hand features and no blood or needles.
Hold the branded end card for 2.5 seconds. Wordmark, one serif line, lime pill, and the phone as secondary text.
Primary click goes to the unit ctaHref (the implant quiz). The phone number may be spoken or set in caption text. Cross-posting follows distribution.json.

cadence.organic: Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday. Stories are 3 to 5 short clips a week and are not a substitute for the feed posts.
cadence.paid: One angle at a time. Do not launch the offer cluster until the copy in ads.json is the copy on the screen.
cadence.batch: Film 4 to 6 short videos in one sitting. Change scrubs between setups so the weeks do not look identical.

primaryCta.labelRule: About two minutes and nine questions. Never promise a faster quiz.
